reasons: The cited clause makes Vendor the 'sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term' — full-term exclusivity binding Customer with no category narrowing, no 12-month limit and no performance-based exit, which fails the fallback and sits at the rule's walk-away position; deviation status is correct.

Deletion of Section 2.2 is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer); no salvageable fallback wording exists in the sentence to narrow, and the exclusivity runs against Customer rather than benefiting it.

Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, concise and in first person plural; it explains the deletion, cites the playbook position, notes the internal conflict with Sections 2.1/12.3, and offers the fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic termination on service-level or delivery failure).
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no residual sole-supplier/requirements obligation on Customer remains after the edit.
